entries.text: Oops: The other side of the door is the spawning place of the goblin this sorcery was used or taught by.
entries.raw_text: 1,Oops: The other side of the door is the spawning place of the goblin this sorcery was used or taught by.

entries.text: Long ways to go: Traversing the tunnel takes d6 hours.
entries.raw_text: 1,Long ways to go: Traversing the tunnel takes d6 hours.

entries.text: Goblins: d4 goblins are lurking within the tunnel, just in case you would happen to wander through.
entries.raw_text: 1,Goblins: d4 goblins are lurking within the tunnel, just in case you would happen to wander through.

entries.text: Horror: An undead, demon, spirit, or some shadowy beast is lurking within the tunnel, preying upon unwary passengers.
entries.raw_text: 1,Horror: An undead, demon, spirit, or some shadowy beast is lurking within the tunnel, preying upon unwary passengers.

entries.text: Shadows: Travellers are cursed to see everything as though it was night at all times. No light is bright enough, no colours distinct.
entries.raw_text: 1,Shadows: Travellers are cursed to see everything as though it was night at all times. No light is bright enough, no colours distinct.

entries.text: Shadowy sight: Travellers can henceforth see in dim light as well as cats.
entries.raw_text: 1,Shadowy sight: Travellers can henceforth see in dim light as well as cats.

entries.text: Reduction: Travellers are gradually turned to size of the goblinkin.
entries.raw_text: 1,Reduction: Travellers are gradually turned to size of the goblinkin.

entries.text: Permanency: The doors and the tunnel are permanent.
entries.raw_text: 1,Permanency: The doors and the tunnel are permanent.

entries.text: U-turn: The exit point of the door is the same as the entry point.
entries.raw_text: 1,U-turn: The exit point of the door is the same as the entry point.

entries.text: Scared: When leaving the tunnel the one who opened the door casts Boo! on the others who are treated as surprised.
entries.raw_text: 1,Scared: When leaving the tunnel the one who opened the door casts Boo! on the others who are treated as surprised.

entries.text: Infused: When leaving the tunnel one character with little magical or mental ability acquires some and can henceforth open a goblin door at will.
entries.raw_text: 1,Infused: When leaving the tunnel one character with little magical or mental ability acquires some and can henceforth open a goblin door at will.
